lines.trans: What is your problem? Didn't I tell you to get out of this cab right now?!

words.gram: Adverbial く-form of 早い (early) modifying 帰って.

lines.trans: I'm Muranishi — I direct adult videos.
Your angry expression right now is far more human and wonderful.
What were you thinking, tearing me apart in front of a whole crowd like that?!
With raw talent this fine, it baffles me how anyone could cook up such a terrible dish.
I want to hear from you yourself whether you'll appear in my film.
Do you really think you'll get away scot-free with poaching me behind my agency's back?
Why not live your own life for yourself? Faking every single day has to bore you to death.
I've never even heard of a director by your name — stop lecturing me from on high!
How much does Poseidon pay you per video?
Five hundred thousand yen. Wait — what am I supposed to do with this cash?

meanings.note: Read なん before だ/です/の, and なに before が/を or alone.

examples.text: 何を買いにきましたか。
examples.trans: What did you come to buy?

meanings.en: casual reflection or firm reminder particle
meanings.note: Used aloud to oneself ('man, I'm hungry') or at the end of a warning ('remember that, okay?').
Links a modifying noun to a following noun, or turns a clause into an explanatory statement (often contracted to ん in speech).
Tells the listener something new or adds warm reassurance at the end of a sentence.
Adverbial form 早く urges someone to hurry up.

examples.trans: I woke up early in the morning.

meanings.note: Polite sentence-ending counterpart of plain だ.

cells: ではありません / じゃありません

meanings.note: Written を and pronounced o; marks what an action directly acts upon.
All-purpose action verb; turns Sino-Japanese nouns into verbs (融通する, 出店する) and with に means 'decide on' or 'make into'.

examples.text: 怒った今の表情のが、よっぽど人間らしくてすてきですね。
examples.trans: Your angry expression right now is far more human and wonderful.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。
examples.trans: It's an expression often heard on set.

meanings.note: Can stand at the head of a sentence without a particle ('right now').
Marks the subject of existence, emergence, or questions (どれが), and at the end of a polite clause softens a request (のですが).

examples.text: お願いがあるのですが。
examples.trans: I have a favor to ask.

examples.text: 悪かったな、この間はすっぽかしたりして。
examples.trans: Sorry about blowing you off the other day.

examples.text: 現場でよく聞く言葉だ。

meanings.note: Refers to humans in general or human nature.

examples.text: 人間には表と裏がある。
examples.trans: Human beings have a public face and a hidden side.

meanings.note: Evidential auxiliary adjective expressing hearsay or inference.

examples.text: 百万冊以上売れてるらしい。
examples.trans: Apparently it sells over a million copies.

meanings.en: come; go do something and return (after て-form)
meanings.note: Written in kana after a て-form (話してきます), expresses stepping away to do an action and coming back.

examples.text: ちょっと水を買ってきます。
examples.trans: I will go buy some water and be right back.

meanings.note: Checks agreement ('isn't it?') or softens a request or farewell.
Combines どう (how) + いう (say); どういうこと means 'what does this mean?'.

examples.trans: What is the meaning of this?

meanings.note: Read ひと when standing as an independent noun.

examples.text: 親切な人に会いました。

meanings.note: Refers to facts, matters, or affairs rather than physical objects (もの).

examples.text: 仕事のことを話します。

meanings.en: location of action; means; scope total
meanings.note: Marks where an action happens, the unit/scope of a rate or total (十日で, 全部で), or the cause/occasion.

examples.trans: It is one thousand yen in total.

meanings.note: Standalone pronoun ('this'), unlike この which requires a noun.
Godan verb.

examples.text: このペンを使ってもいいですか。
もっと英語を使いましょう。

meanings.note: Irregular verb: くる -> きます -> きました.

examples.text: 俺も金なんとか集めるからよ。もうちょっと明るくやろうや。
examples.trans: I'll scrape together some money too, so let's keep our spirits up.

examples.text: ああ。リスクもあるが、懸けてみるか、トシ。
examples.trans: Yeah. There's risk involved too, though—ready to take the gamble, Toshi?

examples.text: 強制送還の金がかかるだけで、何の見せしめにもならないだろ？
examples.trans: Deporting them just costs money and doesn't serve as an example to anyone, right?

meanings.note: Turns a statement into a question, or softens a volitional/negative guess.
na-adjective.

examples.text: 彼には不思議な魅力がある。

meanings.note: Negates verbs or forms じゃない ('is not') in questions like いいんじゃないか.
Second-person pronoun used by superiors, in songs/books, or between close friends.

examples.text: 君の意見はどうですか。
君ならきっとできるよ。

meanings.note: Used among friends and peers by men; switch to 私 or 僕 in formal settings.

meanings.en: target, location of existence, or result marker
meanings.note: Marks destination, location where something exists or sits, or the chosen result before する and なる.
Asks about condition, outcome (どうだった), or what happened (どうしましたか).

examples.text: お前ら、観光じゃないんだからしっかりしろよ。
examples.trans: Hey, this isn't sightseeing, so pull yourselves together.

examples.text: 彼女は来るんだろうな？
ちゃんとキャストはそろってるんだろうな？
examples.trans: You've got the whole cast properly lined up, right?

meanings.note: Colloquial particle, often used to downplay or dismiss.

examples.text: テレビなんか見ていないで勉強しろ。
コーヒーなんかどうですか。
examples.trans: How about some coffee or something?

meanings.en: to think; to feel; to believe
meanings.note: Often follows quotative と to express an opinion or belief.

examples.text: それはいいと思います。

meanings.note: Reflexive pronoun pointing back to the person under discussion.

examples.text: 自分の言葉で話します。
examples.trans: I speak in my own words.

meanings.note: Refers to a person's life, career, and experiences.

examples.text: 人生を諦めないでください。
examples.trans: Please don't give up on life.

meanings.note: Ichidan verb.
Attaches to a past-stem verb form to set up a condition ('if a fire starts').

examples.text: 火事になったら大変です。
examples.trans: If a fire breaks out, it will be terrible.

examples.text: 家に帰ったら電話します。
examples.trans: I will call when I get home.

meanings.note: Plain sentence-ending copula; contracts or shifts to だった in past, だろう/だろ for supposition, and で/じゃ in combinations.
Compound of 偽 (false) + 物 (thing); opposite of 本物.
Temporal noun used adverbially without a particle.

examples.trans: You're busy every day, aren't you?

なら.gloss: if it is; in the case of

examples.trans: If it were you, what would you do?

examples.text: 明日なら時間があります。
examples.trans: If it is tomorrow, I have time.

meanings.note: Replaces は, が, or を to add 'also' or 'too'.

examples.trans: Please give me this one too.

examples.text: あそこも新しい店です。
examples.trans: Over there is a new shop too.

meanings.note: Marks the presence of a person (責任者はいるか) or follows て-form (often contracted to てる/てます in speech).
Used in everyday farewells like またね, また明日, and また会いましょう.

examples.text: また明日会いましょう。
